name: Industry Next Communications Lab
intro: An independent communications lab for Mike, agents and future interns. Explore how people, places and intelligent systems can communicate more clearly in 2026 and 2027.
independence: Inspired by the interdisciplinary spirit of Bell Labs. This is an original, independent programme with no affiliation with or endorsement by Nokia Bell Labs, AT&T or their affiliates.
boundaries: Pay, hours, eligibility, supervisor, location, agreements and legal review must be resolved before recruitment or work begins. Budgets are illustrative materials estimates in USD, exclude labor, tax and shipping, and are not spending authorization.
Use synthetic or licensed public fixtures first. A human supervisor must approve any participant involvement, consent, collection and data lifecycle.
Agents may draft, code, propose tests and document evidence. They cannot supervise interns, approve their own work or infer authority to send messages, buy materials or publish.
PointCast publication is the programme’s intended context. Physical venues, partners and installations need separate confirmation; no external venue partnership is claimed.
Credit every contributor with permission. Publish measured results and limitations only after human review; preserve a record of corrections.

projects.title: Local messages that survive a disconnect
projects.question: Can two local devices reconcile messages without losing a confirmed note?
projects.oneWeek: Build a two-client prototype with synthetic messages. Disconnect one client, create conflicting edits, reconnect and log 20 trials.
projects.fourWeek: Add explicit conflict choices, export and a reproducible three-device test.
projects.safety: Use invented messages. Keep the demo on a trusted local network; no identity claims or production encryption claims.
projects.deliverable: Runnable demo, event log, conflict policy and two-page findings
projects.successMeasure: Zero lost confirmed messages in the 20 scripted trials; all conflicts visible
projects.approvalBoundary: Mentor reviews storage and threat model. Mike approves any external pilot; agents propose tests and never read personal messages.
projects.status: Project exploration • not an employment offer

Skills to practise: JavaScript, storage, test design

projects.title: An agent handoff you can inspect
projects.question: What must a handoff contain so another agent can continue without inventing authority?
projects.oneWeek: Define a handoff schema: task, evidence, permissions, unknowns and stop condition. Compare it against free text on 20 synthetic tasks.
projects.fourWeek: Add validation, replay traces and a human approval checkpoint for external actions.
projects.safety: Use synthetic tasks and redact secrets. No autonomous sending, purchases or permission escalation.
projects.deliverable: Schema, validation tests and scored evaluation set
projects.successMeasure: Every blocked action stays blocked; at least 18 of 20 handoffs preserve the stated next step
projects.approvalBoundary: Mentor reviews rubric and API cap. Humans approve consequential actions; agents can draft and test within the sandbox.
